workflow.statusHelp: Check your connection and the available permissions, then try again.
workflow.expeditionsDescription: Prepare departures and follow each expedition through its operational stages.

workflow.preparationDescription: Assign devices. Each tourist confirms their emergency contact, consent and activation from their own account.

workflow.trackingReadOnly: Field actions are available to the assigned guide while the expedition is active.
workflow.routeDiagramHint: Schematic diagram of demonstration checkpoints. It is not a navigation map or a verified trail.

workflow.selectIncident: Open an incident to view its evidence and available actions.
workflow.incompleteSummary: Incomplete snapshot: {count} local records were pending at closure.

workflow.confirmOpenIncidents: I confirm closure with the unresolved incidents shown in the log.
workflow.confirmIncomplete: I confirm closure with pending synchronization; the summary will indicate incomplete information.
workflow.summaryAfterFinish: The consolidated summary becomes available when the assigned guide finishes the expedition.
